title: Delegated PRs merge on a thorough required CI gate with owner-gated exceptions
acceptance: AGENTS.md states the owner's standing grant: agents branch, commit, push, open a PR and squash-merge their own PR when the final head is green, except owner-gated paths; deploys, deletion and owner-approved stay ungranted.
The required CI job fails a PR touching owner-gated paths unless it carries owner-approved, and its own tests run first and have been watched failing.
The required CI job runs the Playwright e2e smoke and uploads per-page screenshots as an artifact, green on Linux on the PR's final head.
agent-prompts/delegate-task.md and .github/pull_request_template.md give a hand-off brief and PR evidence sections, linked from the prompt index, README and CLAUDE.md.
Codex's RF-97 session corrections are carried forward intact and point at the standing grant.

evidence.summary: 4/4 pass locally; two deliberate mutations (dropping the AGENTS.md gate, forcing pass) each failed 3/4. Dry run against PR #641's real file list failed without the label and passed with it.
pnpm e2e passed 2/2 (desktop-1440, phone-390) in 16s on macOS with 10 screenshots after installing Chromium. Not yet run on Linux CI.
Work PR, opened as a draft to claim the task. Owner-gated (needs-owner). The ci.yml commit waits for the workflow token scope.

GitHub Actions on Linux for bfc2622: all steps passed including RF-trace, D1 integration, build, Playwright e2e (10 screenshots uploaded as e2e-screenshots); the final owner-gate step failed as designed because #643 touches owner-gated paths and lacks owner-approved.

resolution: Standing delegation grant, owner gate and e2e smoke are in the required CI job. On GitHub Linux (run 40610775187, bfc2622) every check passed, including the Playwright smoke at 1440 and 390 with a 10-screenshot artifact; the owner gate, run last, correctly failed this owner-gated PR pending owner-approved. Merging #643 publishes this; deployment is not involved.
